import sys, json, random, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import planner, controller, stress2, verify
from collections import deque
stats=[]
orig=planner.repair_potentials
def patched(g,pi):
    d=list(pi); queued=[True]*g.n; pend=deque(range(g.n)); n=0
    to,cap,cost,nxt,head=g.to,g.cap,g.cost,g.nxt,g.head
    while pend:
        n+=1
        u=pend.popleft(); queued[u]=False; base=d[u]; i=head[u]
        while i>=0:
            if cap[i]>0:
                v=to[i]; cand=base+cost[i]
                if cand<d[v]:
                    d[v]=cand
                    if not queued[v]: queued[v]=True; pend.append(v)
            i=nxt[i]
    stats.append((n,g.n,len(g.to)))
    return d
planner.repair_potentials=patched
worst=0
for seed in range(60):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    per=[rng.choice([1,4,8,16]) for _ in range(8)]
    case=stress2.big_case(rng,S=rng.choice([64,256]),J=rng.choice([128,512]),F=8,G=rng.choice([0,8,32]),per=per)
    out=controller.run(json.dumps({'version':3,'cases':[case]}).encode())
    assert 'results' in out
    verify.FAIL=[]
    verify.verify_case(case,out['results'][0],0)
print('max pops', max(s[0] for s in stats), 'max n', max(s[1] for s in stats), 'budget ratio worst',
      max(s[0]/(400*s[1]) for s in stats))
PYEOF
